headline: Scorchhowl Skills
title: Aniimo Scorchhowl Skills | Burn Breaker and Fire Kick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Scorchhowl is a Fire damage dealer with two great skills. Burn Breaker is a charged blast, and at max charge it spends your remaining energy, adding more damage for every extra ten energy used. Fire Kick is a flaming dive that dodges an attack, and a successful dodge deals bonus damage. Save energy for a big Burn Breaker. Do you use Scorchhowl? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Charge it for a huge blast

description: Scorchhowl is a Fire DPS in Aniimo. Burn Breaker charges into a blast that scales with leftover energy, and Fire Kick dodges then dives for bonus damage.
